title: Azure Lighthouse - Simply Explained
description:
Learn how Azure Lighthouse lets MSPs and enterprises manage multiple Azure tenants securely without sharing passwords, using roles and delegations.

An outside company can manage your Azure setup without ever holding your password. That's what Azure Lighthouse does, and it's Microsoft's fix for a weekly headache.In this episode of Simply Explained you will learn:
  • The Two Houses Problem
  • What Azure Lighthouse Actually Is
  • The Handshake: How the Door Gets Built
  • Who Uses It and Who Approves It
  • The Security Story: Who Really Holds the Keys
  • What Azure Lighthouse Is Not
  • The Recap and One Question
Simply Explained by M365.FM breaks down Microsoft 365, Azure and modern IT topics in clear, jargon-free language. Hosted by Mirko Peters.
